Pull request overview Updates this repository’s Microsoft Teams (Microsoft 365 app) manifest schema reference from 1.28 to 1.29, keeping the inventory and repository guidance aligned for this export-and-packaging codebase. **Changes:** - Bumped `manifest.json` `$schema` URL and `manifestVersion` to 1.29. - Updated the human (`docs/technology-inventory.md`) and machine (`docs/technology-inventory.json`) technology inventories to reflect the 1.29 manifest schema and current review status. - Updated `AGENTS.md` repository structure and “confirmed” technology notes to reference schema v1.29.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | manifest.json | Updates Teams manifest schema URL and `manifestVersion` to 1.29. | | docs/technology-inventory.md | Updates inventory date and manifest schema entry to 1.29 with “current” guidance. | | docs/technology-inventory.json | Updates `asOf` and manifest schema technology record to 1.29 and marks it current. | | AGENTS.md | Aligns repo guidance and “confirmed” architecture notes with schema v1.29. |
Review details ### Suppressed comments (1) **AGENTS.md:27** * `exports/` currently contains both `ask-jamie!.zip` and `ask-jamie!.updated.zip`, but the repo guide describes a single retained packaged export (`exports/ask-jamie!.zip`). This extra archive risks confusion about which artifact is canonical and can lead to manifest/inventory drift. Consider removing `exports/ask-jamie!.updated.zip` (or replacing `ask-jamie!.zip` with the updated artifact) so there is exactly one retained export, matching this documentation and the safe-change conventions. ``` - `manifest.json`: Microsoft Teams app manifest, schema version 1.29. It points to the declarative agent definition. - `declarativeAgent_0.json`: Checked-in declarative agent definition, version v1.8. It contains the agent instructions, six conversation starters, and `CodeInterpreter` and `GraphicArt` capability declarations. - `color.png`, `outline.png`: Manifest icon assets. - `exports/ask-jamie!.zip`: Retained packaged export containing `manifest.json`, `declarativeAgent_0.json`, and the two icon assets. - `.agents/skills/`: Bundled Agent Skills and skill-maintenance tooling. These are repository guidance/tooling assets, not application runtime dependencies. The tree includes package evaluations, references, scripts, tests, and retained Foundry benchmark workspace evidence. ``` - **Files reviewed:** 4/5 changed files - **Comments generated:** 0 - **Review effort level:** Lite
